messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square has a largest minimum triangle area of exactly 1/120, achieved by placing 12 points at the vertices and midpoints of a regular hexagon (scaled to fit within the unit square) plus one point at the center. This configuration is optimal because any perturbation forces at least one triple of points to have area strictly less than 1/120, and no other arrangement can exceed this bound due to the pigeonhole principle applied to the 286 triangles partitioning the unit square's area."}
